# DIU Cover

> Generate print-ready Daffodil International University cover pages for Lab Reports, Course Assignments, and Lab Finals. Fill a short form, preview an A4 layout, and download as PDF, DOCX, PNG, or JPG.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Choose the cover type (Lab Report, Assignment, Lab Final).
- [Form](/form): Enter student, course, and submission details, plus optional extra text and images.
- [Preview](/preview): Preview the generated cover and download as PDF, DOCX, PNG, or JPG.
